correctness.rationale: For KG(n,2), the unsigned K_n incidence B gives BB^T=(n-2)I+J and A=J_N+I-B^TB. Hence the Laplacian eigenspaces are constants, ker B of dimension N-n, and B^T(1^perp) of dimension n-1, with distinct eigenvalues for n>=5. PBH demands at least N-n independent dedicated controls. At equality, complement U of n unactuated pair-vertices has invertible unsigned incidence exactly when every component is odd unicyclic (e=v and nonbipartite). The remaining eigenspace imposes zero-sum signs on the controlled graph; only at n=6 and balanced K_3,3 can an obstruction survive, giving ten two-triangle complements. Species/EGF rooted-tree attachments to odd cycles yields exp((artanh T-T)/2) minus ten at n=6. Independently enumerating all 252 candidate complements n=5 gives 162 valid; all 5005 n=6 candidates give 2520 valid and 10 excluded two-triangle cases. Finite checks corroborate, analytic proof is all n.
